import{createSlice,createAsyncThunk}from'@reduxjs/toolkit';import nrcRemarkService from"../services/NRCRemarkService";const initialState={nrcRemarks:[],isError:false,isSuccess:false,isLoading:false,message:''};// Get NRC Remark
export const getNRCRemarks=createAsyncThunk('nrcRemarks',async(_,thunkAPI)=>{try{return await nrcRemarkService.getNRCRemarks();}catch(error){const message=error.response&&error.response.data&&error.response.data.message||error.message||error.toString();return thunkAPI.rejectWithValue(message);}});export const NRCRemarkSlice=createSlice({name:'nrcRemarks',initialState,reducers:{reset:state=>initialState},extraReducers:builder=>{builder.addCase(getNRCRemarks.pending,state=>{state.isLoading=true;}).addCase(getNRCRemarks.fulfilled,(state,action)=>{state.isLoading=false;state.isSuccess=true;state.nrcRemarks=action.payload.data;}).addCase(getNRCRemarks.rejected,(state,action)=>{state.isLoading=false;state.isError=true;state.message=action.payload;});}});export const{reset}=NRCRemarkSlice.actions;export default NRCRemarkSlice.reducer;
